tasks.name: Set Up Code Submission Database

tasks.name: Set Up Tutorials and Hints Database

tasks.description: Test all backend components for functionality and performance.

tasks.name: Deploy Application
tasks.description: Deploy the ACM Problem-Solving Platform to a production environment.

T1.implementation_approach: Use a design tool like Figma or Adobe XD to create wireframes and mockups for the Problem Repository UI.
T1.notes: Focus on user-friendly navigation and search functionality.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints to handle problem creation, retrieval, update, and deletion.
T2.notes: Ensure proper validation and error handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Design and create database schema for storing problem data.

T4.implementation_approach: Design the interface for users to submit code solutions.
T4.notes: Include code editor and submission button.

T5.implementation_approach: Create API endpoints to handle code submission and execution.
T5.notes: Integrate with a code execution engine.

T6.implementation_approach: Design database schema for storing code submissions and results.

T7.implementation_approach: Design the leaderboard interface to display user rankings.

T8.implementation_approach: Develop backend logic to calculate and update leaderboard rankings.

T9.implementation_approach: Create database schema for storing leaderboard data.
T9.notes: Consider using triggers for automatic updates.

T10.implementation_approach: Design the interface for displaying tutorials and hints.
T10.notes: Ensure content is easily accessible and readable.

T11.implementation_approach: Implement backend services to manage tutorials and hints content.
T11.notes: Include version control for content updates.

T12.implementation_approach: Design database schema for storing tutorials and hints.
T12.notes: Optimize for quick retrieval of content.

T13.implementation_approach: Design the user profile interface to display user information and activity.

T14.implementation_approach: Develop backend services to manage user profile data.
T14.notes: Ensure secure handling of user data.

T15.implementation_approach: Create database schema for storing user profile information.

T16.implementation_approach: Perform unit and integration testing on frontend components.
T16.notes: Focus on user interaction and UI behavior.

T17.implementation_approach: Conduct unit and integration testing on backend services.

T18.implementation_approach: Perform database testing to ensure data integrity and performance.
T18.notes: Test for data consistency and query performance.

T19.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using a cloud service provider.
T19.notes: Ensure scalability and reliability of the deployment.
